info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Deposit Lending By Loan Id-spec
info.description: This API allows users to access detailed lending information for deposits associated with a specific loan ID. By providing the loan identifier, consumers can retrieve vital data regarding deposit lending terms, amounts, and other pertinent details. Typical consumers include financial institutions, banks, and applications needing integration with lending data for customer service and reporting purposes. This endpoint enhances service efficiency by enabling quick access to detailed financial information.

get.summary: Retrieve details of a specific loan.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific loan identified by its unique loan ID. You will receive all relevant data associated with the loan, including its terms, status, and borrower information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to fetch the details of a specific loan identified by LOAN-500045. Please ensure that the request adheres to the expected JSON structure defined in the schema.

GetDepositLendingByLoanIdRequest.description: String representation of the request body for the GET operation related to loan details.
